sections.body: Out-of-pocket maximum. The most you pay in a plan year; then insurance pays 100%.

sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Once deductibles, copays, and coinsurance total the out-of-pocket max, the plan pays all covered costs for the rest of the year. It is the true worst-case number of a health plan. Educational content only — not financial advice. Consult a licensed insurance professional for your situation.
